clarification_sources.source_reference: English scheme XML: Sections A-H; classes A99-H99; subclasses A99Z-H99Z and their notes; main groups A99Z 99/00-H99Z 99/00
clarification_sources.note: Official WIPO IPC 2026.01 scheme package; the retrieved bytes match the Task 104 authoritative SHA-256. Only symbols, concise titles, notes, and paraphrases are recorded; the package is not committed.

clarification_sources.source_version_or_date: Guide to the International Patent Classification; 2026 edition
clarification_sources.note: Official WIPO 2026 Guide PDF. It establishes the hierarchy, broadly indicative section titles, residual-place semantics, and the special 99Z 99/00 mechanism. The PDF is not committed.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section A, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section A subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: The official material defines A99Z by a negative, section-relative classification condition. Section A is only a broad indication spanning several distinct human-necessity areas, so the evidence does not supply a positive technical characteristic or narrower coherent locus that can be translated without invention.
assessments.uncertainty: Future subject matter placed in A99Z may support a narrower locus, but no such subject matter is identified by the residual place itself; translatability and boundary compatibility therefore remain undetermined.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section B, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section B subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: The official material defines B99Z by a negative, section-relative classification condition. The multipart Section B title is a broad indication rather than a positive common technical characteristic of every possible residual item, so no narrower coherent locus can be stated without adding content.
assessments.uncertainty: The residual may receive technically diverse performing-operation or transporting subject matter; without item-specific official clarification, translatability and boundary compatibility remain undetermined.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section C, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section C subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: Section C has extensive official scope notes, but C99Z still gathers whatever qualifying Section C-related subject matter lacks another IPC place. Those notes do not turn that negative remainder across chemistry and metallurgy into one positively delimited substantive locus.
assessments.uncertainty: A concrete residual technical subject could be assessed separately, but the class-level remainder does not determine a topic-preserving locus or its boundary compatibility.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section D, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section D subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: The official textile terminology notes clarify terms used within Section D but do not positively define D99Z. Its negatively delimited remainder can span distinct textile and paper subject matter, so a single coherent coverage locus cannot be affirmed from the residual semantics alone.
assessments.uncertainty: No specific residual technical content is supplied from which to test a neutral translation or recurrent-improvement compatibility.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section E, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section E subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: Although Section E has a relatively compact broad title, E99Z is defined by absence from all other IPC places plus closest relation to the section, not by a positive fixed-construction function or object shared by every possible residual item. Coherence is therefore not established.
assessments.uncertainty: A narrower locus may become defensible for particular future E99Z contents, but the residual class alone leaves neutral translatability and boundary compatibility undetermined.

assessments.section_title: MECHANICAL ENGINEERING; LIGHTING; HEATING; WEAPONS; BLASTING
assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section F, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section F subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: Section F expressly spans several broad technical areas. F99Z supplies no positive technical feature unifying their unallocated remainder, so treating the official residual set as one coherent Domain locus would add a stronger unity than the source establishes.
assessments.uncertainty: The official place is valid for classification, but no specific residual subject matter is available to determine a neutral locus or boundary compatibility.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section G, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section G subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: The Section G notes describe difficult classification choices among systems, combinations, and purposes, while G99Z remains a negative remainder. The broad title Physics cannot be substituted for that remainder, and no positive common locus is supplied.
assessments.uncertainty: A concrete G99Z classification could reveal a defensible locus, but the class-level residual semantics leave topic-preserving translation and boundary compatibility undetermined.

assessments.official_residual_title: SUBJECT MATTER NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR IN THIS SECTION
assessments.residual_semantics: A section-relative residual place for subject matter not otherwise provided for in Section H, most closely related to subject matter covered by Section H subclasses, and not explicitly covered by a subclass of another section.
assessments.rationale: The detailed Section H notes distinguish basic and applied electricity and allocate many electrical applications elsewhere. H99Z still identifies only the unallocated section-relative remainder, not a positive technical feature shared by all such subject matter, so a coherent locus is not established.
assessments.uncertainty: The official residual mechanism does not identify concrete H99Z contents from which neutral translatability or recurrent-improvement boundary compatibility could be determined.

rationale: Official IPC 2026.01 material clarifies that each X99Z 99/00 is a legitimate, section-relative residual place considered only when no other IPC place provides for the subject matter. For each section independently, that negative classification envelope does not by itself establish a positive coherent Domain coverage locus. Residual status alone neither passes nor excludes an entry, so all eight remain unresolved under the prospectively fixed three-part gate.
uncertainty: The clarification closes no residual question. Later official same-classification evidence about concrete contents could support successor reassessment, but no cross-entry grouping, normalization overlay, candidate, stable ID, eligibility decision, or authorization follows from this record.
